goal: Lets developers test BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules in Bitcoin Core ahead of any future soft fork
Protects against legacy consensus flaws like quadratic sigop hashing and difficulty timewarp attacks
agreement: Broad concept support for implementing BIP 54 logic without mainnet activation (0xB10C, fjahr, fanquake)
Verified through extensive mutation testing across all rules against the Inquisition branch (instagibbs)
Unanswered question on test coverage for cache and mempool reorg edge cases (ariard)
Request for pre-activation mempool sigops test coverage remains open (ViniciusCestarii)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it implements consensus fixes for quadratic sigop hashing, timewarp, and Merkle collisions
Restricting activation to regtest removes immediate urgency while enabling critical consensus testing
